title: PH60311: Gamma-Ray Spectroscopy And Nuclear Structure
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Nuclear Structure (Theoretical basis): Shell model and residual interaction,
Deformed shell model, Rotational bands and the particle-rotor model, Fast
nuclear rotation and the cranking model.Nuclear Structure (Experimental basis)
: Heavy-ion fusion reaction, Formation and decay of compound nucleus, Nuclear
instrumentation and coincidence technique, gamma-ray spectroscopy of high-spin
states, measurement of lifetimes of excited nuclear states.Exotic nuclei and
Radioactive beams : Nuclear structure at extremes of stability, Drip-line
physics : nuclear halos, nuclear skins, Neutron- and proton-rich nuclei;
Radioactive Ion Beams : isotope separation on-line (ISOL) and in-flight
fragment separation (IFS) experimental methods
